en.summary: Scarlet fever often starts with fever, sore throat and swollen neck glands, then a sandpaper-like rash and strawberry tongue. NHS: see a GP (phone ahead). Antibiotics are clinician-prescribed. Seek help again if not better in a week, scarlet fever with chickenpox, or illness weeks later (possible complication).
seeDoctorIf: Not better in a week after seeing a GP
Unwell after contact with scarlet fever
doNot: Do not send children back to school until advised (often 24h after first antibiotic dose)

fr.summary: Scarlatine : fièvre, angine, ganglions, puis éruption rugueuse et langue framboise. Voir un médecin (appeler avant). Antibiotiques = prescription. Pas de schéma inventé.

he.summary: שנית: חום, כאב גרון, בלוטות, ואז פריחת נייר זכוכית ולשון תות. רופא (להתקשר מראש). אנטיביוטיקה — מרשם בלבד.

ru.summary: Скарлатина: лихорадка, боль в горле, железы, затем сыпь «наждак» и малиновый язык. К врачу (позвонить заранее). Антибиотики — по рецепту.
